name: event_id
description: Stable event key: evt- plus 16 hex chars of sha256(incident_id:sequence). Required by quality checks.

name: sequence
description: Lifecycle step within the incident, starting at 1. Required.

name: service
description: Owning service. Required and constant per incident.

name: severity
description: One of critical, high, medium, low. Required.

name: status
description: One of open, acknowledged, mitigated, resolved. Required.

name: summary
description: Synthetic symptom text used to look up a runbook.

name: event_ts
description: When the lifecycle change happened (UTC). Required, must not be in the future.

name: batch_date
description: Delivery date of the batch that carried the event. Partition column; one batch replaces one partition.

name: ingested_at
description: When the loader wrote the batch (UTC).
